26255-sonny-boy.title: Sonny Boy
26255-sonny-boy.creator: Sophie Swett
26255-sonny-boy.description: A book by Sophie Swett. Mamma Plummer read a letter at the dinner-table before she touched her soup. She had been having visitors and had not had time to look at it before. And she was always in a hurry to hear from Aunt Kate.

4641-starr-king-in-california.title: Starr King In California
4641-starr-king-in-california.creator: William Day Simonds
4641-starr-king-in-california.description: A book by William Day Simonds. It is believed that no important data has been overlooked, and it is hoped that a genuine service has been rendered to all students of California History, and to all lovers of Starr King--he who was called by his own generation, "The Saint of the Pacific Coast."

arxiv-2101-04579.title: An efficient quantum algorithm for the time evolution of parameterized circuits
arxiv-2101-04579.creator: Stefano Barison, Filippo Vicentini, Giuseppe Carleo
arxiv-2101-04579.description: Abstract We introduce a novel hybrid algorithm to simulate the real-time evolution of quantum systems using parameterized quantum circuits. The method, named "projected - Variational Quantum Dynamics" (p-VQD) realizes an iterative, global projection of the exact time evolution onto the parameterized manifold. In the small time step limit, this is equivalent to the McLachlan’s variational principle.

arxiv-2105-01789.title: Characterization of Thermal Infrared Dust Emission and Refinements to the Nucleus Properties of Centaur 29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1 Journal: the Planetary Science Journal
arxiv-2105-01789.creator: Charles A. Schambeau, Yanga R. Fernández, Nalin H. Samarasinha, M. Womack, Dominique Bockelée-Morvan, Carey M. Lisse, Laura M. Woodney
arxiv-2105-01789.description: Abstract We present analyses of Spitzer observations of 29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1 using 16 μ \mu m IRS “blue” peak-up (PU) and 24 μ \mu m and 70 μ \mu m MIPS images obtained on UT 2003 November 23 and 24 that characterize the Centaur’s large-grain (10-100 μ \mu m) dust coma during a time of non-outbursting “quiescent” activity.

arxiv-2209-05827.creator: T. Barklow, E. Barzi, S. Belomestnykh, M. Biagini, M. Chamizo Llatas, J. Gao, E. Gianfelice,
arxiv-2209-05827.description: Abstract Chapter 0 Accelerators for Electroweak Physics and Higgs Boson Studies Abstract: We discuss the goals, the designs, the state of technical readiness, and the critical R \& D needs of the accelerators that are currently under discussion as Higgs and electroweak factories. We also address the respective staging options enabling future energy-frontier colliders.

arxiv-2306-11428.title: Intrinsic alignment from multiple shear estimates: A first application to data and forecasts for Stage IV 2023 Intrinsic alignment from multiple shear estimates: A first application to data and forecasts for Stage IV – D
arxiv-2306-11428.creator: Charlie MacMahon-Gellér, C. Danielle Leonard
arxiv-2306-11428.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Charlie MacMahon-Gellér, C. Danielle Leonard. Without mitigation, the intrinsic alignment (IA) of galaxies poses a significant threat to achieving unbiased cosmological parameter constraints from precision weak lensing surveys. Here, we apply for the first time to data a method to extract the scale dependence of the IA contribution to galaxy-galaxy lensing, which takes advantage of the difference in alignment signal as measured by shear estimators with different sensitivities to galactic radii.

arxiv-2309-13502.title: Globally Solving a Class of Bilevel Programs with Spatial Price Equilibrium Constraints
arxiv-2309-13502.creator: Akshit Goyal, Jean-Philippe P. Richard
arxiv-2309-13502.description: Abstract Bilevel programs with spatial price equilibrium constraints are strategic models that consider a price competition at the lower level. These models find application in facility location-price models, optimal bidding in power networks, and integration of renewable energy sources in distribution networks.

arxiv-2505-20524.title: Towards Fully FP8 GEMM LLM Training at Scale
arxiv-2505-20524.creator: Alejandro Hernández-Cano, abcdefghijk Dhia Garbaya abcdefghijk, abcdefghi Imanol Schlag abcdefghi, abcdefghijk Martin Jaggi abcdefghijk
arxiv-2505-20524.description: Abstract Despite the significant potential of FP8 data formats for large language model (LLM) pre-training, their adoption has been limited due to challenges in maintaining stability at scale. Existing approaches often rely on suboptimal fine-grained FP8 kernels or fall back to higher-precision matrix multiplications (GEMMs) in sensitive components, such as attention projections, compromising potential throughput gains.

pmc-10528862.creator: Aymen Hawani, Anis ben Chikha, Mohamed Abdelkader Souissi, Omar Trabelsi, Maher Mrayah, Nizar Souissi, Santo Marsigliante, Antonella Muscella
pmc-10528862.description: The feeling of pleasure during physical education (PE) could increase with physical activity participation and adherence for overweight children. While traditional games are known to have positive benefits on motor skill development, especially for children with poorer motor skills, and on the body mass of children, little is known about overweight children’s feelings of enjoyment when playing these games.

pmc-10632420.title: Daylong acoustic recordings of grazing and rumination activities in dairy cows
pmc-10632420.creator: Luciano S. Martinez-Rau, José O. Chelotti, Mariano Ferrero, Santiago A. Utsumi, Alejandra M. Planisich, Leandro D. Vignolo, Leonardo L. Giovanini, H. Leonardo Rufiner, Julio R. Galli
pmc-10632420.description: Monitoring livestock feeding behavior may help assess animal welfare and nutritional status, and to optimize pasture management. The need for continuous and sustained monitoring requires the use of automatic techniques based on the acquisition and analysis of sensor data. This work describes an open dataset of acoustic recordings of the foraging behavior of dairy cows.

pmc-10936407.description: This paper presents results of a search and analysis of research projects on animal welfare registered in the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) database in the period 1996–2019, with the aim of gaining a better understanding of developments in animal welfare science in China.

pmc-11355036.description: Crohn’s disease (CD) is a type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) affecting the gastrointestinal tract that can also cause extra-intestinal complications. Following exposure to the mRNA vaccine BNT162b2 (Pfizer-BioNTech) encoding the SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) protein, some patients experienced a lack of response to the biological drug Adalimumab and a recrudescence of the disease.

pmc-11431772.title: Association between Motoric Cognitive Risk Syndrome and Indicators of Reflecting Independent Living among Community-Dwelling Older Adults in Japan: A Cross-Sectional Study

pmc-11431772.description: The purpose of this study was to examine whether motoric cognitive risk syndrome (MCR) is associated with various indicators of independent living among community-dwelling older adults in Japan.
